# Liftover comparison across species

```{r}
library(dplyr)
```

## reciprocal steps
First, because liftOver is strict about column, so it is needed to extract only column 1-6.
for example
```{bash}
cut -f1-6 ../../peaks/macs3_results/human_TE_only.bed > human_TE_only_6col.bed
cut -f1-6 ../../peaks/macs3_results/chimp_TE_only.bed > chimp_TE_only_6col.bed
cut -f1-6 ../../peaks/macs3_results/oran_TE_only.bed > oran_TE_only_6col.bed
```


Here I run a bash script, `reciprocal_comparison.sh`

and the result is
|     |       |       |        |
|-----|-------|-------|--------|
|     | H     | C     | O      |
| H   | 2,077 | 1     | 17     |
| C   |       | 5,754 | 0      |
| O   |       |       | 10,098 |

Three-way conserved: 0
